title: Backup
intro: Backs up your Claude ecosystem: the skills and scripts you wrote, command history, session history, and images you pasted into conversations. Caches and runtime state are left out. Credentials are never included — but the bundle still identifies you, so don't publish it.

blocked.dir_not_dir: That path is not a folder.
blocked.inside_source: This folder sits inside the data being backed up, so the backup would end up containing itself. Pick somewhere outside your Claude directories.
blocked.invalid: The saved location is not a valid absolute path. Choose it again.
blocked.is_home: Your home folder is too broad for this. Pick a dedicated folder.
blocked.is_root: The filesystem root is not a valid backup location.
blocked.not_configured: Choose where backups should go. Keeping them on the same disk as the originals is no protection at all.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save the backup location.
